name: Crispy Najdi Lamb Sambusa (سمبوسة لحم نجدية باللومي)
description: Golden crispy whole-wheat pastry parcels stuffed with spiced minced lamb, caramelized onions, and tangy black lime.

name: Najdi Pumpkin & Red Lentil Soup (شوربة العدس والقرع النجدي)
description: Velvety roasted Najdi pumpkin and red lentil soup infused with toasted cumin, garlic, and nigella seeds.

name: Savory Cheese & Za'atar Masabeeb (مصابيب مالحة بالجبن البلدي والزعتر)
description: Warm whole-wheat Najdi mini medallions topped with melted local cheese, wild za'atar, toasted sesame, and a drizzle of Talh honey.

name: Smoked Eggplant & Fiery Shaqra Chili Dip (متبل باذنجان مدخن بفلفل شقراء والجوز)
description: Fire-roasted eggplant blended with creamy tahini, fiery Shaqra red peppers, crunchy walnuts, and tangy pomegranate molasses.

name: Traditional Najdi Lamb Jareesh (جريش نجد التقليدي باللحم والسمن البري)
description: Slow-cooked crushed wheat simmered for hours with tender lamb and tangy laban, finished with wild ghee and black lime onion kishna.

name: Vegan Almond-Milk & Wild Mushroom Jareesh (جريش نباتي بحليب اللوز والفطر)
description: A plant-based take on classic Najdi Jareesh slow-cooked in rich almond milk with roasted wild mushrooms and spicy loomi kishna.

name: Najdi Vegetable Matazeez (مطازيز نجد بالخضار الموسمية)
description: Hand-pressed whole wheat dumplings simmered in a spiced tomato and black lime broth loaded with seasonal Najdi vegetables.

name: Braised Lamb & Pine Nut Qursan (قرصان نجد باللحم والصنوبر)
description: Delicate layers of paper-thin whole wheat Qursan bread soaked in rich lamb broth, topped with tender meat, vegetables, and toasted pine nuts.

name: Smoked Hashi Kabsa (كبسة حاشي نجدية مدخنة)
description: Aromatic long-grain basmati rice cooked in spiced young camel broth, smoked over embers and garnished with toasted almonds and raisins.

name: Fiery Shaqra Chicken Kabsa (كبسة دجاج شقراء الحارة بالمعبوج)
description: Flame-grilled chicken over saffron-spiced rice, served with a fiery Shaqra chili and roasted garlic maabouj crust. Completely nut-, dairy-, and gluten-free.

name: Roasted Najdi Pumpkin & Chickpea Kabsa (كبسة القرع النجدي والحمص النباتية)
description: Fragrant spiced basmati rice topped with sweet roasted Najdi pumpkin, hearty chickpeas, and tangy black lime kishna.

name: Fiery Green Maabouj & Tomato Daqoos (ثلاثية الدقوس النجدي والمعبوج الأخضر)
description: House-made trio of crushed green Shaqra chili maabouj, smoky roasted tomato daqoos, and garlic-herb oil.

name: Najdi Rocca, Sukkari Date & Pecan Salad (سلطة الجرجير بالتمر السكري والبيكان)
description: Peppery Qassim rocca leaves tossed with sweet Sukkari dates, crunchy pecans, tangy labneh pearls, and sumac dressing.

name: Warm Najdi Hanini with Wild Ghee (حنيني نجدي دافئ بالسمن والفستق)
description: Traditional Najdi winter delicacy of rich Sukkari dates kneaded with toasted whole-wheat crumbs, cardamom, and wild ghee, topped with pistachios.

name: Spiced Kleicha & Tahini Ice Cream (آيس كريم الكليجا النجدية بالطحينة)
description: Crunchy spiced date-filled Kleicha cookies sandwiching artisanal cardamom ice cream with a rich roasted sesame tahini swirl.

name: Saudi Blonde Coffee & Sukkari Dates (قهوة سعودية شقراء بالزعفران مع تمر سكري)
description: Traditional Najdi dallah of blonde coffee brewed with premium cardamom and saffron, served alongside hand-picked Sukkari dates.
